name: FeedOracle DORA OS
description: Compliance evidence infrastructure for regulated entities and their AI agents. MiCA stablecoin authorization, DORA operational resilience (all articles), AMLR/sanctions screening, and reserve/risk scoring across 6 FeedOracle-branded oracles. Also draws on a larger shared compliance-infrastructure mesh (OracleNet) for extended coverage -- see feedoracle.io/data/feedoracle-metrics.json for current combined totals. Every response is ES256K + ML-DSA-65 signed and anchored to independent randomness beacons. Free tier via self-registration (kya_register), no API key needed to start.
author: FeedOracle Technologies
